name: solidity-milestone-crowdfunding
title: Milestone token crowdfunding
description: Goal-based token funding with contributor-weighted milestone approvals, beneficiary releases and failure refunds.
assumptions: A successful campaign locks unapproved funds indefinitely unless future milestones gain majority approval. There is no contributor rage-quit or beneficiary guarantee. Weight equals historical contribution; milestone votes require a strict majority of total funding. Failed campaigns refund principal.
